text:
Lina: Heads up - I'm prepping a small refresh for the 'Hello Apprentice' quickstart. Main goals: streamline auth (use REDWOOD_TOKEN), add a short SDK v3->v4 migration note, and tighten the Dockerfile example (bumped base). Will open a PR this afternoon.

Arjun: Sounds good. Can you also add a tiny 'what to expect on first deploy' section? New hires keep tripping on port mapping and env var order.

Lina: Yep, planning a 3-item checklist: set REDWOOD_TOKEN, map port 8080, and add a /health endpoint.

Priya: Also the example code in the quickstart still uses client.generate(...) from v3. We should show the v4 pattern with await client.responses.create(...) and a minimal JSON response shape.

Lina: Good catch. I'll include a compact example:```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN })
const res = await client.responses.create({ model: 'open-7b', input: 'Hello' })
console.log(res.output[0].content[0].text)
```

Arjun: Keep it under 6 lines please. Tiny snippets are easier to scan.

Lina: Will do. Also adding an inline note: "If you're on SDK v3, replace client.generate with client.responses.create and update import path".

Priya: There's a broken anchor on the quickstart that links to "auth/examples" but the right path is "auth#examples" (site routing mismatch). Can we fix that in the same PR?

Lina: Yes, I'll update the anchor and add a redirect comment in the PR.

DocsBot: markdown-link-check failed: docs/quickstart/hello-apprentice.md -> broken link to /auth/examples (404).

Lina: Fixing now. Also discovered the sample Dockerfile uses ubuntu:18.04; switching to debian:stable-slim. Will note the reason in the changelog entry.

Arjun: After your PR, I can run the staging lab and validate the healthcheck and env var names.

Lina: Thanks. Plan: open PR #4270 with description: "hello-apprentice: auth -> token, SDK v4 snippet, docker base bump, small deploy checklist".

Priya: Quick nit - in the migration note, remind users to update any scripts that read API_KEY env var to REDWOOD_TOKEN. Simple one-liner replace example would help.

Lina: Good idea. I'll add:```bash
# replace in bash scripts
export REDWOOD_TOKEN="$API_KEY"
```

DocsBot: lint/formatting warning in quickstart file: line endings should be lf.

Lina: Will run the formatter before assigning reviewers.

QA-bot: Staging smoke script queued for branch lina/hello-apprentice (job #604).

Lina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4270 - tagging @Arjun @Priya for review.

Arjun: Reviewing now. Small request: add a tiny troubleshooting subsection "if you see 401" with suggested checks (token, env, build cache).

Lina: Done. Added three bullets: token present, correct env name, clear build cache and redeploy.

Priya: LGTM after DocsBot warnings resolved. :+1:

DocsBot: All markdown checks passed after formatting.

QA-bot: Staging smoke passed for branch lina/hello-apprentice. Healthcheck OK.

Arjun: Merging after CI green. I'll also run a quick smoke on the prod gate after merge.

Lina: Merging in ~30m. I'll post a short note to #announcements with the updated quickstart link and a one-line migration note.

Priya: Thanks Lina! Small but helpful update for onboarding. :rocket:
